head: abf83df601f8
answers: The reviewer's round-1 changes request at 50a3a587: all eight important findings and all four minor ones, none deferred. Nine threads answered and resolved.

proof.criterion: Finding 1: whenSent answers from the report taken before the re-mark, so the retry goes out before the server can see the mark - the very failure this issue reports
proof.surface: The margin's wait and the composer, through their own React tests, and the whole compose-wait browser suite against the real Go server and PostgreSQL 17.11
proof.command: cd packages/dispatch && bun test --parallel web/src e2e/__tests__ ; cd packages/dispatch && bun run e2e -- compose-wait
proof.observed: A new features/doc/pending-waiter.ts answers a wait only from a report of that document taken after the wait began, with the bound as the backstop; the pending report is reset when the artifact changes; whenSent returns Promise<void>. The composer registers with the margin (registerComposer/keepDraft), so the automatic re-send carries what the reader has typed rather than what the 300 ms debounce last wrote. 2974 unit tests pass, and 11 compose-wait rows pass (6.1m).
proof.negativeControl: Dropping the keepDraft call turns the new margin row red ('the margin's own re-send carries what the reader typed while it waited'); the waiter's own test fails if a report taken before the wait is allowed to answer it.

proof.criterion: Finding 2: a selection across two blocks never re-anchors, and the reader is told it was changed or deleted while it is on the page
proof.surface: The browser suite, plus the proof-editor unit suite
proof.command: cd packages/dispatch && bun run e2e -- compose-wait
proof.observed: The document is read as one text, break and all, with an index from text offset back to document position, so a quote that spans a paragraph break is found by the re-anchor and by the decision between 'gone' and 'unplaceable'. New row 'a comment on words that run across two paragraphs keeps its anchor' is green: the selection spans the break, the sweep takes the mark while the author is away, and Send attaches the comment over both halves. The mislabelled unit test that claimed to cover this is corrected, and two real cross-block unit tests added.
proof.negativeControl: The second cross-block unit test is the control for the exactly-one rule: the same quote reading twice across four paragraphs refuses 'unplaceable' rather than attaching.

proof.criterion: Findings 3 and 4, and the two minor editor items: the tracking plugin cannot answer in production, two refusal sentences are false, and the scans are duplicated
proof.surface: The proof-editor and margin unit suites
proof.command: cd packages/proof-editor && bun test src/tests tests ; cd packages/dispatch && bun test --parallel web/src e2e/__tests__
proof.observed: The plugin and everything only it needed are deleted and removeRecordMark is back to its old contract; the re-anchor order is the live mark, then the selector. Two surrounded readings of the reader's own block answer a new 'ambiguous' reason, and a compose whose document is not on screen answers a sentence that says so instead of claiming the words were deleted. One readingsOf helper replaces readingCount and the double scans. 227 proof-editor and 2974 dispatch tests pass.
proof.negativeControl: margin-context.test.ts asserts the three unchanged sentences word for word and that only the 'words read nowhere' sentence says 'changed or deleted', so a wrong sentence in any of the five cases fails it.

proof.criterion: The server finding: the minute is counted from the last sweep that saw the author, not from the author's last presence, so an idle reconnect takes the mark
proof.surface: The Go docs package against PostgreSQL 17.11
proof.observed: ok (149s). roomState.departed records when each user's last browser left the room, a reconnection clears it, and the sweep ages a mark from the later of that time and its first-seen time, re-arming settlement from the same instant. Three new tests: the reviewer's scenario with the drop one second before the re-armed sweep, a reconnection before the deadline, and two tabs of one author.
proof.negativeControl: Ignoring the recorded departure in the sweep fails TestAnUnrecordedMarkOutlivesASweepRunJustAfterItsAuthorDropped and TestAnUnrecordedMarkAgesFromItsAuthorsLastBrowserNotTheFirstToClose; the control was run and removed.

proof.criterion: Nothing else in the application broke
proof.observed: 934 passed, 1 failed (1.1h) at abf83df601f8. The one failure is e2e/hover-preview.e2e.ts:87.
proof.negativeControl: That row is not this change's: it fails on main@origin in this same pod with nothing of this branch in the tree, which I measured in round 3 and the tester confirmed.

filesChanged: packages/envoy/internal/dispatch/docs/roomstate.go, websocket.go, marks.go, marks_test.go (the author's last presence)
packages/proof-editor/src/record-mark-retype.ts, lib.ts, dispatch-marks.ts, dispatch-action-bar.ts and their tests (plugin deleted, cross-block text, one scan, the ambiguous reason)
packages/dispatch/e2e/compose-wait.e2e.ts (my own eleventh row only; the tester's four rows untouched)
trickyParts: The wait had to be for a report taken after the call, not for the last report: the store counts a local update only once its IndexedDB write is through, so on a quiet document the report that exists when the margin asks was taken without the new mark in it.

Flushing the draft needed the composer to register with the margin, because the margin owns the re-send and the composer owns the text; a composer with no send of its own registers nothing and the retry behaves as before.

A cross-block selection has no block and no surroundings, so it is matched on its words alone in the document read as one text. That is the one place the exactly-one rule carries the whole decision, which is why the second cross-block test refuses two readings.
deviations: The minor suggestion to move the placement code into its own proof-editor module is declined in this round and said so on its thread: the split needs biome.json and packages/proof-editor/AGENTS.md edited with it, since that AGENTS.md enumerates every legion-owned file under src/, and with the tracking plugin gone the module is 486 lines on one subject.
openQuestions: The reported 'about ten seconds' is still unexplained, as every round has recorded.
e2e/hover-preview.e2e.ts:87 fails in this pod on main as well as here; CI is where it is watched.
discoveredComplexity: The simplify pass is spent (round 1, ce-simplify-code at 96a647eb, applied). A round answering a review runs no second pass.

Never use `jj restore <path>` to undo a temporary negative control: it restores from the parent commit and takes the whole round's work in that file with it. It cost me margin-context.tsx once here, recovered with `jj op restore` from the working-copy snapshot. Copy the file aside instead.
